text:
nina_sales: Heads-up: FinCloud (APAC banking customer) wants a POC next week but the contract clause is strict: all request data, model inference, and logs must stay entirely in asia-southeast1 (Singapore). They require a written routing policy, full subprocessor list for APAC, and confirmation that any KMS/HSM used is also in-region or customer-controlled. Can we confirm options and ETA? cc @liam_eng @tara_sec

liam_eng: We can support a "region-pin + fail_closed" policy for hosted and dedicated. Two caveats: (1) model builds must exist in that region, and (2) some large model variants are only built in our US/EU pools. If they insist on asia-southeast1, we either use a compatible regional build (quantized/smaller variant) or provision a Dedicated/Private deployment in APAC.

nina_sales: They will not accept cross-region failover under any circumstances. If we can't serve in-region they want the request to error out.

tara_sec: I'll prep the APAC subprocessor packet and include cloud provider regional attestations + cert chains. Quick question: do they need customer-managed KMS inside asia-southeast1 or is an in-region Redwood-managed KMS acceptable? Please confirm.

liam_eng: We support both. For hosted/dedicated we can configure Redwood-managed KMS in asia-southeast1. For customer-controlled keys we support external KMS/HSM peering; that requires some network setup. Example routing snippet we can give them for the POC: 
```json
{
  "routing": {
    "mode": "region_pin",
    "region": "asia-southeast1",
    "on_miss": "fail_closed"
  },
  "kms": {
    "location": "asia-southeast1",
    "type": "redwood-managed"
  }
}
```
Note: the real policy will be delivered as a one-line JSON in the POC package.

owen_ops: If they want a fast POC with zero infra on their side, we can provision a small Dedicated APAC pool. Provision ETA: ~48-72h after sign-off. If they want Private (on-prem), that's longer (2-4 weeks) due to HSM/KMS integration and networking.

carter_bizdev: Pricing note: short-term Dedicated POC pricing can be pro-rated. Expect ~USD 5-10k for a small GPU-backed pool for a 2 week window depending on instance type. Cross-region egress is what spikes costs — since they're strict about in-region only, egress should be minimal and mostly just intra-region charges.

tara_sec: I'll assemble: (a) APAC subprocessor list (cloud provider, monitoring, logging pipeline), (b) certificate chains for any third parties, (c) SOC2 + pentest retrieval instructions. I need a point of contact at the customer to exchange the SIG.

nina_sales: I'll get the SIG and the exact KMS requirement from the customer today. Also they asked: can we show an audit log proving inference never left region during the POC?

liam_eng: Yes — we can enable request-level routing logs and generate an audit report showing source region, model shard location, and egress path. We'll provide a script to verify logs for the POC.

infra-bot: ticket: apac-dedicated-poc-456 created -> owner: eng-oncall, est: 60h provisioning

nina_sales: Action items: (1) Tara to send subproc & cert bundle by EOD, (2) Liam to list compatible model variants that can run in asia-southeast1 and provide the fail_closed routing JSON, (3) Owen to confirm Dedicated POC ETA and provisioning steps, (4) Carter to share a pro-rated POC pricing sheet, (5) I'll upload SIG when received. Anything else? :white_check_mark:
